name: Unsloth Studio
description: Run Unsloth Studio locally with a pinned, folder-local toolchain.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: Local port for the Studio web interface.

settings.label: Studio config folder
settings.help: Where Studio keeps its settings and database. Defaults to this app's folder.

settings.label: Models folder
settings.help: Where downloaded models are stored. Defaults to this app's folder.

settings.label: Copy my existing Studio config
settings.help: Copies %USERPROFILE%\.unsloth\studio into this install once, so your current Studio settings carry over.

steps.name: Copying existing config
run: $src = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.unsloth\studio'; $dst = '{app}/app'; if (Test-Path $src) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dst | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem $src -Force | ForEach-Object { $target = Join-Path $dst $_.Name; if (-not (Test-Path $target)) { Copy-Item $_.FullName $target -Recurse -Force } }; Write-Output 'copied existing Studio config' } else { Write-Output 'no existing Studio config to copy' }
